copy: Spinner + amber. Triggers on every auto-save or Cmd+S. Duration: typically 200-800ms.
Green dot, straight after the save. Not its own state — saved with a fresh savedAt.
Green dot, grey text. The same saved state as 2 — only savedAt is older. The resting default.
Amber dot + amber text. Unsaved work. Offline is a SEPARATE state: Offline — not saved.
